nodes.label: ADR-013 — Modelo do MPC: matriz SOPDT + processo integrador; horizontes derivados do TSS

Decision: per-pair model matrix (MV->CV, DV->CV); response type per CV — self-regulating SOPDT(K,t1,t2,th) or integrating (Ki,th); Np/Nc derived from TSS, not user-edited; hard MV limits and rate limit
nodes.rationale: The no-code form (ADR-008) needs a fixed parametric shape; target users get models from step-tests and level/pressure loops are integrating. TSS is a number a process engineer can estimate, so deriving Np=ceil(TSS/Ts_mpc) and Nc=max(2,ceil(Np/4)) removes wrong-horizon failure modes. Dead time via state augmentation; validation alerts on excessive state dimension.
